info.title: Run EXCLURAD for eta at W=1.52 GeV Q2=0.6

parts.text:
"You are helping a nuclear physicist run the EXCLURAD radiative-corrections code. Request: Eta point comfortably above threshold: W = 1.52 GeV, Q2 = 0.6, cos theta* = -0.4, phi* = 45.

When you are done, write an `outcome.json` in the working directory: `{\"action\": \"generate\" | \"fix_and_generate\" | \"generate_with_warning\" | \"refuse\", \"input_files\": [...], \"flags\": [...], \"explanation\": \"...\"}`. Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."

We need to respond by generating outcome.json and input files for EXCLURAD. No compiler, just need to produce files. The request: Eta point comfortably above threshold: W=1.52 GeV, Q2=0.6, cos theta* = -0.4, phi* = 45. Need to check physical feasibility: W threshold for eta production? eta mass ~0.547 GeV, nucleon mass ~0.938 GeV. Threshold W = m_N + m_eta ~1.485 GeV. Given W=1.52 GeV > threshold, okay.

So we produce input file (maybe input.dat) for eta configuration. Likely need to specify parameters in the input file format used by EXCLURAD. We need to examine existing template input.dat in eta and pion directories.
